profile_text.body:
Dify is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Suzhou, China. The company operates a platform it describes as built for production-ready agentic workflows, allowing teams to build AI agents, knowledge pipelines, models, and tools on a single collaborative canvas. The platform can be deployed on cloud, in a private VPC, or self-hosted, and the company positions it as suitable for teams moving from prototype to production without rebuilding their stack. Dify also describes the platform as a no-code environment intended to make AI agent development accessible to beginners as well as experienced developers, and Volvo Cars is cited on the company's site as an organization using the product.

The site's tracked product, also called Dify, falls in the coding and developer tools category and supports workflow orchestration and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines. It is open-source, and the held facts note that cross-border data review is advised for prospective users. Teams can extend the platform through a marketplace of model providers, tools, data sources, and MCP integrations, and plugins can be reused across projects. Dify also has a presence in the MCP server registry through an integration associated with ClickUp workspace management. No litigation or regulatory filings are recorded in the held facts.
